query_normalized: quantifying the impact of data resolution on simulated fluid turbulence physics
rationale: This paper satisfies acceptance criteria (a) and (b) because it directly measures the relationship between spatial and temporal resolution parameters (grid convergence, $κ_{max} η_0$, $Δt$) and the accuracy of simulated fluid turbulence statistics, which is the core mechanism and variable set of the user's question. It provides the specific empirical criteria for how resolution impacts the fidelity of Direct Numerical Simulation (DNS) in turbulent flows.
